content.comment_body: Hello, I'm seeking advice regarding an issue with a product alarm system using two [product_name] devices. Earlier today, the program on one device was lost (I've found and resolved the cause), but now I'm having trouble copying the program from the working device onto a module for transfer. I followed the instructions from the manual, but the program isn't copying onto the module. The module is from RS and has a manufacturer part number of [article_no]. Any help or insights would be greatly appreciated.

Hi, could you clarify how you are transferring the program—are you using a cable or a memory card? What steps have you taken so far? Did you set the [product_name] to transfer mode? I recognize the part number indicates a memory card ([article_no]). This card is compatible only with [product_name] models from [version_no] onwards. Which model are you using? Which memory or battery cards match which device series?

I'm attempting the transfer by putting the program onto a memory card, following the manual's instructions. Section 5.4 details copying a program from the module or card to [product_name]: you can do it automatically upon startup (power on) or via the device's menu. Notably, not all programs on the modules are readable by every [product_name] variant—refer to Section 5.1 if needed. The automatic method involves: 1) Powering down the device, 2) Removing the cover shaft, 3) Inserting the program module/card, and 4) Powering up again. Afterwards, the device should display its main menu, where you can proceed to start and confirm the transfer. The memory card I'm using has a manufacturer part number of [article_no]. I'm uncertain which model it is—how can I check this?

Your memory card is only compatible with [product_name] versions [version_no] and up. Your model appears to be a maximum of [version_no], so that card won't work. The version number (e.g., [version_no]) is typically indicated on the base module, just below the buttons.
It seems my units are [version_no] ([article_no]). Could you advise which card is needed and let me know if those are still available?

You require: [article_no] [product_name] PROGRAM MODULE BLUE, or alternatively the Yellow or Red versions. However, none of these are currently available (I've checked RS and Conrad). Using [product_name] software and a programming cable might be a better solution, as swapping the device should be straightforward. Note that your current module is an older model.

analysis.insight_summary: A user encountered issues transferring a program between two older [product_name] units using a memory card. The core problem was the incompatibility between the memory card and the hardware version of the device, along with the modules and cards required for older versions being discontinued. Contributors clarified version compatibility and recommended using programming software and cables as an alternative, highlighting the challenges of supporting legacy hardware and a need for clearer compatibility documentation.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates being able to easily copy programs between devices using a memory card, as described in the manual. They expect information on compatible modules, cards, and potential alternative solutions in case of product obsolescence.
